name: sentinel
description: A durable PostgreSQL-backed workflow orchestration engine.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sentinel/api && npm run build -w @sentinel/worker && npm run build -w @sentinel/dashboard
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sentinel/config && npm run build -w @sentinel/contracts && npm run build -w @sentinel/database
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n api,worker,dashboard -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @sentinel/api" "npm run dev -w @sentinel/worker" "npm run dev -w @sentinel/dashboard"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/api && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/worker && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/dashboard
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @sentinel/config && npm run build -w @sentinel/database && node packages/database/dist/migrate.js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run deployment:check && npm run build
